keyFindings.description: The controller's notice lane and Slack mention topics never reach the listener: subscribeNotice marks them role-bound ('so no registration ever carries it') and registerSession filters role-bound subjects and every notifications.legion.> subject out. The base opened a core subscription for them (base envoy.ts:3439, subscribeUnlessRoleEnds); this change removed it, so the controller receives no daemon notice and no Slack mention. The listener's new holder rule (bus.ControllerNoticeRole) is reached only by curl. No plugin-level test registers the lane through the real registration.

SubscribeInput.delivery is now required; envoy-plugin was not migrated, so `bun run typecheck` in packages/envoy-plugin fails TS2345 twice (reproduced), and parseSubscribeAnswer throws on the no-delivery answer a serving-port registration gets.
writeFileSync left unused after writePreConsumerServer was deleted; claude-envoy's typecheck fails TS6133 (reproduced).

The stand-in listener answers /v1/interests/subscribe with no delivery field (the new client throws) and the notice is published raw on core NATS, which nothing subscribes to any more; these tests run on Actions (skip is false there). The deep review ran one locally: it failed after 154 s.

envoy_subscribe of an uncaptured topic, or of a wildcard whose bare base is uncaptured (notifications.team.>, notifications.github.>), is kept in `followed` and answered 'Subscribed'; every later registration then carries it and the listener refuses the whole registration 400, so the session's interest lapses, role claims fail, and a restart restores the topic.

The route reads roles only when body.Topics names the controller lane; UpsertWithin reads them when the stored row names it too. A heartbeat omitting the lane drops it from the consumer filter while the row keeps it, contradicting MergedTopics' own invariant. One read, one merge.
The load test still defaults to -session-delivery core, which sends no delivery object, so every registration is now 409 not_requested; the errors are only counted. Delete the core mode.

RequestCoreTo, StartRequestCoreTo, PublishCore, PublishCoreTo, ErrReceiptTimeout and PendingForward's receipt branch have no production caller left (role_lane.go:131 always calls StartRequestStoredTo); delete them with their tests and the comments that still describe a receipt.
The TS 'mirror' of privateStreamSubjects lacks the team exception lane and the role-aware controller lane exception; add both and a parity test.

A plugin released at merge throws on any listener that answers without `delivery` or with mode core (pre-#2446 builds, or a host user without the consumer grant), leaving the session deaf and the controller unable to claim. The body must state that release order, and acceptance 1's read must count a session whose delivery is null/absent as not on a consumer.
The team exception lane is private, so no session can register it; 'reaches a session's consumer' is false. Give it a reader or correct the text.
